Privacy Policy

Privacy declaration for Sandbox Interactive GmbH (albiononline.com)

Sandbox Interactive GmbH respects your right to control your privacy. We have put in place security measures for your personal data, and manage your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection and data privacy regulations. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle and treat your data when you (i) register or visit our site https://albiononline.com  or associated sites or pages (the "Website"), (ii) use our services, or (iii) engage or communicate with us. It also provides information about your rights relating to your Personal Data. 

Throughout this Privacy Policy the following terms have the following meanings:

"Data Privacy Laws" means applicable data protection and data privacy laws and regulations, including but not limited to the EU General Data Protection Regulation (2016/679) (the "GDPR").

"Processing" and "Process" means all activities involving your Personal Data, including collecting, handling, storing, sharing, accessing, using, transferring, and disposing of information.

"Services" means our applications, games, and other products, the website, email communications, social media accounts, and any related services or properties we control.

"Personal Data" means Personal Data that relates to you as an identified or identifiable individual.

All capitalized terms not specifically defined herein shall have the meaning ascribed to such terms in the GDPR.

While operating our Services, Personal Data will be shared with partners that we work with. Some of these partners are Controllers independent of us and, therefore, they independently determine how and for what purpose they process your data. For more information on these partners and the ways in which they may process your data, please refer to section 4 of this Privacy Policy. Under certain circumstances we will transfer your Personal Data to countries outside the European Economic Area. Such transfers will be done in accordance with section 5 of this Privacy Policy.

Our Services are not directed toward children and we do not knowingly collect Personal Data from children under 16 years of age.


1. Who we are

Controller

The Controller responsible for your Personal Data for the purposes of the GDPR is:

Sandbox Interactive GmbH
Pappelallee 78-79
10437, Berlin, Germany
privacy@sandbox-interactive.com
http://albiononline.com 

hereinafter referred to as "the Company", "we", "us", or "our".

The principles set out in this Privacy Policy apply to all instances in which the Company processes your personal data as a Controller for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy. The Company is part of the Stillfront Group, a global group of gaming studios with its parent company, Stillfront Group AB (publ), incorporated in Sweden and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. 

Data protection Officer

The data protection officer of the Controller for the purposes of the GDPR is:

Name:  Peter Birgersson, Deloitte AB
Contact details: dpo@stillfront.com


2. What information do we collect from you?

2.1 Information you provide voluntarily when using our Services:

Your name, email address, or other contact information communicated to us.

Any Personal Data provided in any communication channel available in our Services.

Payment information in a reductive format, for example the first 6 and last 4 digits of your credit card, as well as other required  information such as your full name and email address, depending on your chosen payment method.

Any other information you choose to submit to us through our Services, direct communication channels, or otherwise.

If you participate in our surveys or other research, any comments, feedback, responses, or other information you provide to us when doing so.

2.2 Directly from you and/or your device by automatic means:

Your use of our Web Services: we track and collect usage data including but not limited to information about the browser type and version used; the operating system of the accessing device; the IP address of the accessing device; the date and time of access and websites from which the system of the accessing device reaches our website; hashed login and session information.

Your use of our Game Services: we track and collect usage data including but not limited to the date and time you access our services; access status; duration of use of our services; times of log-in; IP address; information about actions in the game; user messages/chat protocols; information on the operating system used; technical information about the device and hardware used to play the game; information about running processes, drivers and other executable code, as well as game-related and operating system-related files and memory.

Crash logs including but not limited to snapshots and screen captures at the time of the crash, or other information related to bugs, errors, or other issues with our Services.

Inferences we make based on your activity in our Services.

We do not expect or intend to collect or otherwise process any special categories of data relating to you. By special categories of data, we mean genetic, biometric or health information, information revealing racial or ethnic origin, sex life or sexual orientation, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, or information about your criminal offenses or convictions. Please do not provide this kind of information to us, or use the Services to make it available to others.

The Company collects Personal Data directly from you and/or your device (such as your phone or computer) by automatic means when you use our Services, including through cookies and similar technologies, or software development kits (SDKs). For more information regarding the Company's use of cookies, please view our Cookie List at https://albiononline.com/cookies .


3. How do we use your Personal Data?

We use your Personal Data for different purposes. We will, for example, use Personal Data to provide you with the Services you have requested, to improve and develop our Services, to predict user trends, to make recommendations and carry out marketing activities based on your usage, and to customize our Services to you. This includes the following processing activities:

3.1 Processing is necessary to perform our contract with you as regards our Services. (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR):

The data provided is used to identify the user by creating an account. The account enables the user to use our services and products.

Data provided by you is used in the handling of requests, in particular support requests for technical problems with the game and the handling of other questions. 

The data provided by you, as well as automatically collected data, is used for the technical implementation, operation, and provision of the game. The specific purpose of saving logs is for the technical improvement of our services (quality assurance). To prevent program crashes and other malfunctions in the future, it is necessary to record and analyze them. In the case of a crash of our services or a problem in the game process, an error analysis can be performed by reading the logs in combination with your IP and ID and information about the device used. Chat logs are stored in order to be able to follow up on complaints, e.g. because of insults.

The data provided by you is used to manage the payment transaction and to verify its legality.

Automatically collected data is used to provide solutions against cheating and fraud in our services. In practice, this means that  information is gathered about players' interactions in the game, and the gathered information is exchanged between Service Providers and us.

3.2 Consent of the data subject (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR):

The data provided by you through your device is used to increase the convenience of using our website.

The data provided by you, as well as automatically collected data, is used to optimize our communication with our existing users as well as sending you interest-based advertisements along with marketing of our services and those of the Stillfront Group.

Both the data provided by you and automatically collected data are used to analyze the browsing behavior of our visitors and users. This helps us to continuously improve our website and its user-friendliness.

Data provided by you in surveys is used for the purposes of improving the game and the customer experience when interacting with our game or services.

Delivery of newsletters, update information and game information, including information about patches, updates, community events, special promotions, personalized updates, interesting information about the development of our games and services and, if applicable, offers related to our game.

Stored relevant payment information and methods submitted by you are used for future transactions.

Data collected through marketing, social media and performance cookies is used to increase the convenience of using our website and to send you advertisements in connection with our Services on different social media platforms.

3.3 Processing is necessary for compliance with a legal obligation to which the controller is subject. (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. c GDPR):

Data automatically collected, or provided by you, may be stored if necessary to comply with tax, commercial, or legal obligations.

In the unlikely event of a dispute or a criminal investigation, we may be legally obligated to transmit personal data to authorities (e.g. requests for information from investigating authorities) or other relevant entities such as legal or natural persons (e.g. to assert claims).  Your Personal Data may also be disclosed to any regulatory body in connection with the prevention and detection of crime and where the Company considers that there are reasonable grounds to suspect that you may be involved in a breach of the law. Those bodies will then use your Personal Data to investigate and act on any such breaches in accordance with their procedures.

3.4 Legitimate interest of our company to make our Services the best they can be and provide you with the best possible user experience from our Services (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR):

Automatically collected data is used to enable the website to be delivered to the user's device. For this the IP address of the user must remain stored for the duration of the session. The data is stored in log files to ensure the functionality of the website. In addition, the data is used to optimize the website and to ensure the security of our information technology systems. 

We use cookies for the operation, maintenance, and enhancement of our web services, such as cookies that allow users to log in to their accounts or to change website language settings.

The data provided by you, as well as automatically collected data, is used to analyze our services and measure the success of our marketing.

3.5 Based on our legitimate interest to protect our services from cheaters and fraud (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR):

The data provided by you is used to manage payment transactions and to verify their legality, in particular to prevent fraud and to settle any disputes over payment.

We use logs and inferences based on your use of our services for the purposes of preventing violations of our terms and conditions.

Automatically collected data is used to provide solutions against cheating and fraud in our services.

In addition, we may process your data for additional purposes which are compatible with any of the purposes listed above.


4. Who we share your information with

Your Personal Data will (for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy) be transferred or disclosed to third parties, for the processing of that Personal Data on our behalf, for example:

Other companies in the Stillfront Group. Where they help us to develop, improve, or operate our Services will receive access to available and required Personal Data. For information on the entities within Stillfront Group, see the most recent annual report published on https://www.stillfront.com/en/reports-presentations/  and updated from time to time.

For analytical purposes, we collect automatically-generated data such as your recent visits to our services and how you move around different sections, in order to make our services more intuitive and evaluate user needs and preferences. This data will be shared with a limited group of employees in the Stillfront Group.

Persons or companies that provide services to us and process Personal Data on our behalf when providing those services, for example, services that help us develop and operate our Services. A list of these processors can be found at the bottom of this policy.

Professional advisors such as external legal and audit services etc. Personal Data shared will consist of information you provide voluntarily when using our Services and data collected from your device by automatic means. 

Third parties to whom we outsource certain services such as, without limitation, document processing and translation services, confidential waste disposal, IT systems or software providers, IT Support service providers, document, information storage or host providers such as OVH, Gcore, Amazon Web Services, etc. Data shared will consist of information you provide voluntarily when using our Services and data collected from your device by automatic means.

Competent courts of law or other government authorities where we believe disclosure is necessary as a matter of applicable law or regulation, such as the Authority for Privacy Protection in relation to any scrutiny of compliance with GDPR. 

Any person or entity where we believe disclosure is necessary to exercise, establish or defend our legal rights or to protect your or another person's vital interests.

Please note this list is non-exhaustive and there may be other examples where we need to share data with other parties in order to provide Services as effectively as we can.

When Personal Data is shared with our business partners, group affiliates or other trusted entities stated above, we always require them to only use information in accordance with our instructions. We may update the processor list from time to time as needed to fulfill the purposes listed in this privacy notice.


5. Appropriate Safeguards to countries outside the EU/EEA-area

In connection with some processing activities described in this Privacy Policy we share information outside of the European Union ("EU") and the European Economic Area ("EEA"). For example, a number of servers we use for hosting data are located in the United States, and some of our group companies or the service providers we use to provide the Services may be located outside of the EU and the EEA. Where the Company transfers Personal Data outside the EU/EEA, the Company will ensure that Adequacy Decisions apply or Standard Contractual Clauses have been entered into between the transferring entity and the receiving external party. Additional safeguards will also be put in place prior to such transfers.


Data shared will consist of information you provide voluntarily when using our Services, and data collected from your device by automatic means. Under Data Privacy Laws you are entitled upon request to receive a copy of any documentation, demonstrating that appropriate safeguards have been taken in order to protect your Personal Data during a transfer outside of the EU/EEA. You can do so by reaching out to our Data Processing Officer at privacy@sandbox-interactive.com.


6. How long do we retain your information?

We will retain your information only for as long as is necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy. We use the following criteria to establish our retention period: (i) as long as we have an ongoing relationship with you; (ii) as required by legal obligations to which the Company is subject (such as tax and accounting obligations); and (iii) as advisable in light of our legal position (such as applicable statutes of limitations). For more specific information about data retention terms, please contact our Data Processing Officer at privacy@sandbox-interactive.com and we will provide the specific data retention terms for your jurisdiction.


7. Security

Your data is secured by appropriate safeguards, taking into account the circumstances, the state of the art in the industry, the costs of implementation, and the nature, scope, context and purposes of processing as well as the risk. In support of this commitment, we have implemented appropriate technical, physical and organizational measures to protect your Personal Data against unauthorized or accidental destruction, alteration or disclosure; misuse; damage; theft or accidental loss; or unauthorized access.


8. Your rights

Providing data to us is not mandatory. However, we are unable to provide the Services, or some parts or features of the Services, without processing your data. If you use our Services, we will collect data relating to you for some or all the purposes described in this Privacy Policy, depending on the Services you decide to use and your choices made when using them. You have a number of options to limit or control the extent to which your data is processed. For example, you can choose not to connect your third-party accounts with our Services, use your device settings to reset or limit the use of your Advertising ID, or disable some cookies from your browser settings.

In relation to our processing of your Personal Data you can, under certain circumstances, exercise the following rights:

Access

You may request confirmation of whether or not Personal Data is processed and, if that is the case, access to your Personal Data and additional information such as the purposes of the processing. You are also entitled to receive a copy of the Personal Data undergoing processing. If the request is made by electronic means the information will be provided in a commonly used electronic format unless otherwise requested.

Object to certain processing

You may object to the processing of your Personal Data on the basis of a legitimate interest, on grounds relating to your particular situation, and to its processing for direct marketing purposes. 

To unsubscribe from our marketing communications, please use the unsubscribe link provided in the messages we send. The unsubscribe link is typically found at the end of the message.

Rectification

You have at any time the right to have inaccurate Personal Data rectified, as well as, taking into account the purposes of the processing, the right to have incomplete Personal Data made complete. 

Erasure

You may have your Personal Data erased under certain circumstances, such as when your Personal Data is no longer needed for the purposes for which it was collected.

Restriction of processing

Under certain circumstances you may ask us to restrict the processing of your Personal Data to only comprise the storage of your Personal Data, such as when the processing is unlawful but you do not wish your Personal Data to be erased.

Withdrawal of consent

We would like to provide you with regular game updates on social media and reduce the number of generic Albion advertisements shown to you. texts.EN-US:
After having met Arthur, their so-called King, I'm feeling wary about this alliance.

Merlyn has my trust. But the Avalonians are like children - they want everything and believe they're being clever by answering their own questions.

They'd better focus on their promise to remain in Avalon. With no terror from above the roads should be open for trade, not expansion. But I have hope that, like most children, they'll grow up and learn.
texts.ZH-CN:
在见过他们所谓的国王亚瑟之后，我对这个联盟心存戒心。
梅林获得了我的信任。但阿瓦隆人就像孩子 —— 他们想要得到一切，还自以为通过回答自己提出的问题就显得十分聪明。
他们最好恪守留在阿瓦隆的承诺。任何天降灾祸，都不应用来为贸易开辟通路，更不可谋求扩张。但我仍抱有希望，就像大多数孩子一样，他们终会成长并学会道理。
texts.ZH-TW:
見過他們那名所謂的國王亞瑟之後，我對這個聯盟滿心戒備。
梅林獲得我的信任。但阿瓦隆人就像孩童 —— 他們想要得到一切，還以為自己回答自己提出的問題就顯得聰明。
他們最好謹守留在阿瓦隆的承諾。不該靠來自天上的威懾打開通商之路，更不能藉此向外擴張。但我仍抱持希望，就像多數孩子一樣，他們總會長大並學會教訓。

texts.EN-US: At a beautiful waterside view in the Ancient Lands.
texts.ZH-CN: 在远古之地一处景色秀美的水畔。
texts.ZH-TW: 在遠古之地一處風景絕美的水畔。

texts.EN-US:
This is sheer madness!

When we gathered here to decide the fate of the dragons I assumed this to be just a mere formality. Petrify the dragons? We must return to our roots by honoring them, not abandoning them. And all of it behind the Avalonians' back? Preparation for the ritual will take months. Yes, they're pretty oblivious, but either way, this alliance will stand on shaky ground from the very beginning.
texts.ZH-CN:
这纯粹是疯狂之举！
当初我们齐聚此处裁定巨龙的命运时，我本以为这不过是走个过场。将巨龙石化？我们必须回归本源，敬重巨龙，而非放逐它们。更何况这一切还要背着阿瓦隆人暗中进行？仪式的筹备工作要耗费数月之久。是的，他们几乎毫无察觉，但无论如何，这个联盟从一开始就将根基不稳。
texts.ZH-TW:
這簡直是徹頭徹尾的瘋狂！
當我們聚集在此決定龍族命運之時，我本以為這只不過是走個形式。將龍族石化？我們應回歸本源，敬奉龍族，而非遺棄牠們。而這一切，都要瞞著阿瓦隆人進行？儀式的籌備將耗費數月之久。沒錯，他們幾乎毫無察覺，但無論如何，這個聯盟從一開始就根基動盪。

texts.EN-US: Near the Drake in the east.

Finally, I feel the connection to the Soul Streams in my body! Maybe it took me a few days, or weeks, or months longer than the others. But when it worked, the Shaman glowingly praised my portal stone and stressed how smoothly the Spirit Magic flows.

Now my clan can be proud. And my brothers can finally leave me in peace. If I'm really lucky, perhaps I'll even be able to assist with the great ritual.
texts.ZH-CN:
终于，我感受到体内与灵魂之流的联结！或许我比其他人多花了数日、数周，甚至数月的时间。可当完成时，萨满盛赞了我的传送石，并强调灵魄魔法流转得何等顺畅。
如今我的部族可以自豪。我的兄弟们也终于能不来打搅我。倘若我足够幸运，说不定我甚至还能协助那场宏大的仪式。
texts.ZH-TW:
終於，我感受到體內與靈魂之流的連結！或許我比其他人多花了幾天、幾週，甚至數月的時間。但當它終於生效時，薩滿讚賞我的傳送門石，並強調靈魂魔法流動得何等順暢。
如今我的部族可以為我感到驕傲。而我的兄弟們也終於可以不再來打擾我。倘若我足夠幸運，或許我甚至能夠協助那場盛大儀式。

texts.EN-US: Below the ancient bones of a giant creature from the past.
texts.ZH-CN: 在远古巨型生物的遗骸下方。
texts.ZH-TW: 在遠古巨型生物的遺骨下方。

texts.EN-US:
Lately there's been a shadow prowling in my dreams. Haunting me with this feeling of dread. Like I'm standing on the edge of a cliff. Something foul lurks in the abyss beneath my feet. Yet I haven't dared glance down, for fear the horror will materialize upon my gaze. 

Archdruid Merlyn assured me that everything is going according to plan. But every time he brings the sorceress Morgana, a cold shiver runs down my spine. Her smile is calm but her shadow falls restless and hungry.
texts.ZH-CN:
最近有一道暗影在我的梦境中游荡徘徊。挥之不去的恐惧感日夜纠缠着我。我仿佛伫立在悬崖边缘。有某种邪恶之物潜伏在我脚下的深渊里。但我一直不敢向下看，唯恐那恐怖之物会在我目光落下时显现。 
大德鲁伊梅林向我保证，一切都在按计划推进。但每当他带来女巫莫甘娜，一股寒意便顺着我的脊背窜上来。她的笑容平静，可她的影子躁动且充满渴求。
texts.ZH-TW:
近來有一道陰影在我的夢中遊蕩。揮之不去的恐懼感纏擾著我。彷彿我正站在懸崖邊緣。有某種邪惡之物潛伏在我腳下的深淵之中。但我始終不敢向下瞥視，唯恐那恐怖之物會隨著我的目光顯現。 
德魯伊領袖梅林向我保證，一切都照計畫進行。但每當他帶來女巫摩根娜，我便會渾身充滿寒意。她的笑容平靜淡然，可她的影子卻躁動不安，充滿貪婪。

texts.EN-US: To the north, inside a hollow tree in the Ancient Lands.
texts.ZH-CN: 往北走，远古之地的一棵空心古树内部。
texts.ZH-TW: 向北方，遠古之地一棵空心古樹之內。

texts.EN-US:
For generations, my family has guarded this sacred land. I only know home among giants of scale. Soon, the legacy of my ancestors will fade into a distant memory. 
What a shame that we must seek the help of those who have wounded the world in order to tend to its scars. Have they truly left their hubris behind?

We have no choice but to try. Thus, the oracle has spoken. All I can do is hope someday my descendants will see these mighty creatures soaring through the skies once more.
texts.ZH-CN:
世世代代，我的家族守护着这片圣地。我的家就位于庞然巨物之间。不久之后，我先祖留下的传承将会消逝，化为遥远的回忆。 
多么可悲，为抚平世界的伤痕，我们不得不向那些伤害过这个世界的人寻求帮助。他们真的已经摒弃傲慢了吗？
我们别无选择，只能试一试。神谕者如是宣告。我所能做的，唯有期盼有朝一日，我的后代能够再次看见这些强大的生物翱翔于天际。
texts.ZH-TW:
世世代代以來，我的家族守護著這片神聖之地。我的家就處於龐然巨物之間。轉眼之間，先祖留下的傳統便將消散，化為遙遠的回憶。 
實在可悲，我們竟得向傷害過這個世界的人求助，才能撫平世界的創傷。他們真的已經拋棄那份狂妄自大了嗎？
我們別無選擇，只能一試。神諭者已然昭示。我所能做的，唯有期盼有朝一日，我的後代能夠再次見到這些強大的生物翱翔於天際。

texts.EN-US: At the western edge of the Ancient Lands.
texts.ZH-CN: 在远古之地的西部边缘。
texts.ZH-TW: 在遠古之地的西側邊緣。

texts.EN-US:
I'm sorry you overheard my father's harsh words. He's just worried because he doesn't know you. Not like I do.

Our ancestors have fought the Avalonians for so long. I don't think he ever considered that we could become friends. But I'm sure he must just like you when he sees how funny you are. What you taught me about blacksmithing. And how quickly you learned to hunt with my axe.

Join me for the feast tomorrow. Let him see for himself!
texts.ZH-CN:
很抱歉，你无意中听到了我父亲那些刻薄的话。他只是心存顾虑，因为他并不了解你。不像我这么了解。
我们的祖先和阿瓦隆人交战了很长时间。我觉得他从未想过我们能够成为朋友。但我确信，当他看到你有趣的一面时，他一定会喜欢你的。还有你教我的那些锻造知识。以及你拿着我的斧头学习狩猎学得有多快。
明天和我一同参加宴会吧。让他亲眼见识一番！
texts.ZH-TW:
很抱歉讓你聽到了我父親那些刺耳的話。他只是因為不瞭解你才會擔心。不像我這般瞭解你。
我們的先祖與阿瓦隆人交戰了許久。我想他從未想過我們能夠成為朋友。但我確信，等他看見你的風趣，一定會喜歡上你的。還有你教給我的鍛造技藝。以及你如此迅速就學會使用我的斧頭狩獵。
明天來跟我參加宴會吧。讓他親眼見識一番！

texts.EN-US: Next to a peaceful small lake, where a small river pours down into the skies.
texts.ZH-CN: 在一处宁静小湖旁，有一条小河向着天穹倾泻而下。
texts.ZH-TW: 緊鄰一處寧靜的小湖，有小河自此地傾瀉墜向蒼穹。

texts.EN-US:
Earthmother, guide and protect me on my most dangerous hunt. Predator to all, I will make you my prey.

Once noble paragons of the cycle, you've surrendered our cause to corruption.
Once bearers of freedom for the land. But torture brought you to demons' door.
Once, to harm you, was to harm balance. Now you're just a mere lizard gnawing at the roots of the world.

My tears will remember your greatness. While I must hunt you down.

Earthmother, the land will be lush again. Gone will be the scorched earth and the betrayal of the sky.
A last war to win.
texts.ZH-CN:
大地之母，在我这场最凶险的狩猎之中指引并护佑我。你是万物的掠食者，而我要将你变为我的猎物。
你曾是轮回之中高贵的典范，如今却将我们的事业拱手交给腐化。
你曾是这片大地自由的执掌者。可折磨将你推向了恶魔的门户。
曾经，伤害你，便是破坏平衡。如今你不过是一头啃噬世界根须的普通蜥蜴。
我的泪水会铭记你的过往伟大。但是我必须将你追捕猎杀。
大地之母，这片土地将会再度生机繁茂。焚烧的大地与苍穹的背叛都将不复存在。
这是一场必须取胜的终末之战。
texts.ZH-TW:
大地之母，請引導並護佑我完成這場最險惡的狩獵。縱使你是萬物的掠食者，我仍要將你化為我的獵物。
你曾是生命循環高貴的典範，如今卻將我們的大業拱手交給腐化。
你曾是這片大地自由的承載者。但折磨將你推向了惡魔的門前。
從前，傷害你便是在破壞平衡。如今你只不過是一頭啃噬世界根基的蜥蜴。
我的淚水將銘記你的偉大。即便我必須將你獵殺。
大地之母，這片土地必將再度蔥鬱。焦土與來自蒼穹的背叛都將不復存在。
這是一場必須取勝的最後戰爭。

texts.EN-US:
What has happened here? Are these Avalonian manners to leave someone else's study in such disarray? Hundreds of years among Keepers and he still uses these flimsy sheets of paper. Lets see if I can still decipher Merlyns scrawly handwriting.

Has he lost his senses? Use Spirit Magic to affect the Otherworld! That sounds like a disaster waiting to happen. What would we even need this for? He can't possibly be serious. I'd better hide these notes before the other druids see it and get angry. Or worse yet: take a liking to the idea.
texts.ZH-CN:
这里发生了什么？把别人的书房弄得如此狼藉，这就是阿瓦隆人的礼节吗？在看守者当中待了数百年，他居然还在用这些薄脆的纸片。看看我还能不能辨认出梅林潦草的字迹。
他丧失理智了吗？动用灵魂魔法去干涉异界！这听上去就是一场迟早发生的灾祸。我们究竟要这个做什么？他绝对不是认真的。我最好把这些笔记藏起来，免得其他德鲁伊看见后大发雷霆。或者更糟的是：他们会爱上这个主意。
texts.ZH-TW:
這裡究竟發生了什麼事？把別人的書房弄得如此混亂，這就是阿瓦隆人的禮數嗎？與看守者相處數百年，他卻仍舊使用這些薄脆的紙張。來看看我是否還能辨讀梅林那潦草的字跡。
他難道喪失理智了嗎？運用靈魂魔法去干涉異界！這聽起來簡直是一場遲早會降臨的災禍。我們究竟為何要做這種事？他不可能是認真的。我最好把這些筆記藏起來，免得其他德魯伊看見而動怒。更糟的是：他們還有可能會喜歡上這個念頭。

texts.EN-US:
War with the dragons? 
The Avalonians should curse their ancestors for creating their arch nemesis themselves. Tormenting the dragons until either their spirit or their will was broken. This should serve as a warning to them that the pursuit of power always leads to a dire end. So why honor a demand made with the understanding of a child? They'll take care of the demon infestation. We'll take care of the rest. Our way.
texts.ZH-CN:
与龙族开战？ 
阿瓦隆人该诅咒自己的祖先，是他们亲手造就了死敌。不断折磨龙族，直至它们的精神或是意志被摧毁。这应当给他们一个警示：追逐权力终将迎来悲惨结局。那为何要去遵从一个孩童见识下的要求？他们去处理恶魔泛滥的问题。剩下的交由我们来处理。按我们的方式。
texts.ZH-TW:
與龍族開戰？ 
阿瓦隆人該詛咒自己的先祖，是他們親手造就了這些宿敵。不斷折磨龍族，直至牠們的靈魂或是意志崩潰。這理當給他們一個警示：追逐力量終將迎來悲慘的結局。那又為何要遵從一份如同孩童見解般的要求？由他們去處理惡魔肆虐的問題。剩下的交給我們。用我們自己的方式。

texts.EN-US: Where Maeve waits and gazes upon the Soul Streams.
texts.ZH-CN: 梅芙在此守候，凝望着灵魂之流。
texts.ZH-TW: 梅芙於此守候，凝望靈魂之流。

texts.EN-US:
Beloved, the cycle has claimed you. You have laid bare your life to worship the rulers of the sky. To honor the scales of life and death. To walk through fire and through ice.
  
Your steps echo in the footsteps of our ancestors, who have walked this path for millennia. Their trail will guide you in the Streams. 

I cannot follow you where you go. But I know you did not leave me. I feel your warmth in the light of the sun. I hear your voice in the whispers of the wind. I know your presence in the day transcending night. The cycle has claimed you, now your soul is woven into the fabric of the world. Until you return again.
texts.ZH-CN:
吾爱，轮回将你带走。你倾尽一生，敬奉苍穹的主宰。敬守生死的天平。穿行于烈火与寒冰之中。
你的步履回响于先祖的足迹，他们已在这条道路上行走过千年。他们的行迹将在诸流之中指引你。 
你去往的地方，我无法相随。但我知道，你并未离我而去。我于日光之中感受你的温度。我于风的低语里听见你的声音。在白昼冲破黑夜之时，我感知你的存在。轮回接纳了你，如今你的灵魂已编织进世界的本源。静待你再度归来。
texts.ZH-TW:
吾愛，生命循環將你帶走。你曾傾盡一生，敬奉蒼穹的統御者。敬拜生死的天秤。穿過烈火與嚴寒。
你的足跡，與先祖的腳步交相迴響，他們已在這條道路上行走數千年。他們的蹤跡將於諸流之中引領著你。 
我無法追隨你去往彼方。但我知道，你並沒有離開我。我在陽光之中感受你的溫暖。我在風的低語裡聽見你的聲音。在晝驅逐黑夜之時，我感知你的存在。生命循環將你取走，如今你的靈魂已編織進世界的肌理之中。靜待你再度歸來。

texts.EN-US: Next to a fallen Obelisk inside the Dragon Sanctuary.
texts.ZH-CN: 龙之圣域内，一座倾倒的方尖碑旁。
texts.ZH-TW: 龍之聖域內，傾倒的方尖碑旁。

texts.EN-US:
How to care for your draconic best friend:
First you need some good, juicy meat like horse or boar. Be careful not to keep your hands, arms or face too close. Feel the strength of your bond. A few gentle strokes will help - but don't get too attached to your fingers!

The others won't understand. They'll think it's too dangerous. But we'll prove to them that there's true kinship between Keepers and dragons. Soon we'll be flying through the skies together!
texts.ZH-CN:
如何照料你的龙族挚友：
首先你需要一些鲜嫩多汁的肉食，比如马肉或者野猪肉。小心不要将手、手臂或是脸靠得太近。感受你们之间羁绊的力量。轻柔抚摸几下会有效果 —— 但你的手指可未必保得住！
其他人不会理解。他们会认为这太过危险。但我们会向他们证明，看守者与龙族之间存在真正的亲缘纽带。很快我们就会一同翱翔天际！
texts.ZH-TW:
如何照顧你的龍族摯友：
首先你要準備鮮美多汁的肉，例如馬肉或是野豬肉。小心別將手、手臂或是臉湊得太近。感受你與牠之間羈絆的力量。輕輕撫摸幾下會有幫助 —— 只是你的手指可未必保得住！
其他人不會理解。他們會覺得這太過危險。但我們會向他們證明，看守者與龍族之間存在真摯的親情。不久之後，我們便能一同翱翔於天際！

texts.EN-US: In the stomach of a Drake.

texts.ZH-CN: 如何与你的巨龙成为朋友
texts.ZH-TW: 如何與你的巨龍成為朋友

texts.EN-US:
From elements awakened raw
Follow their path in fear and awe.  

Here floating peaks are lost in mist 
The air burns hot with fire's kiss.
Oh, living flame of blaze and flash.
Bow to its will or turn to ash. 

Follow their path, the clap of wings 
The sound of breath like blizzard winds.

Above the thunders of grey clouds 
All is wrapped in frigid shrouds
Eternal winter come to life
In honor you will pay the price.
texts.ZH-CN:
自原始苏醒的诸元素之中
怀着敬畏与恐惧，追随它们的行迹。  
此地浮空峰峦隐没于薄雾 
空气被烈火的灼吻烘得滚烫。
啊，炽烈燃烧的生命之火。
屈服于它的意志，否则便化为灰烬。 
追随它们的轨迹，振翅轰然作响 
吐息之声宛如暴雪狂风。
在灰云雷鸣的上空 
万物被凛冽寒衣所笼罩
永恒寒冬已然苏醒
为致以崇敬，你将付出代价。
texts.ZH-TW:
自原始喚醒的諸般元素
懷著敬畏與恐懼，追隨牠們的足跡。  
浮動的峰巒隱沒於霧靄之中 
空氣被烈焰之吻灼得滾燙。
噢，那熊熊閃耀的活躍烈焰。
順從牠的意志，否則便化為灰燼。 
追隨牠們的蹤跡，聽那羽翼拍擊之聲 
吐息宛若暴風雪呼嘯。
在灰雲雷鳴的高處 
萬物皆籠上嚴寒的幕布
永恆寒冬已然甦醒
你將以敬奉之名付出代價。

texts.EN-US: Lost in a lake in the Ancient Lands.
texts.ZH-CN: 沉沒在远古之地的一处湖泊里。
texts.ZH-TW: 沉沒於遠古之地的一處湖泊之中。

texts.EN-US:
Yesterday I performed the rite. Needles of bone and threads of ancestral souls have inscribed my skin. I can feel their power in my veins.

There is no turning back. We either walk the path to its end or the stars and moon will perish and we will drown in the darkness.
texts.ZH-CN:
昨天我举行了仪式。骨针和祖先灵魂的丝线刻在了我的皮肤上。我能感觉到他们的力量在我的血管里流动。

没有回头路了。我们要么走完这条路，要么星月消逝，我们将沉入黑暗之中。
texts.ZH-TW:
昨天我舉行了儀式。骨針和祖先靈魂的絲線刻在了我的皮膚上。我能感覺到他們的力量在我的血管裡流動。

沒有回頭路了。我們要麼走完這條路，要麼星月消逝，我們將沉入黑暗之中。

texts.EN-US: Sometimes dropped by a Mammoth Hunter.
texts.ZH-CN: 有时会从猛犸象猎人身上掉落。
texts.ZH-TW: 有時會從猛獁象獵人身上掉落。

texts.EN-US:
The Mammoth Hunter passed through our camp today. 

He called on us to join the Ashborn. Only the wisest would know to follow them, and only the bravest would dare to fight. 

The Shaman cursed him when he spoke of dragons, but my eyes eagerly searched the sky. 

When he rested in the shade, I saw his markings glow with Spirit Magic. The Shaman called it shameless, but I'd call it daring.

I'm supposed to stay with my clan, but I'd like to believe that I'm wise and brave.
texts.ZH-CN:
猛犸象猎人今天经过我们的营地。 

他号召我们加入灰烬之子。只有最明智的人才会跟随它们，只有最勇敢的人才敢战斗。 

当他说到龙时，萨满诅咒了他，但我却热切地仰望着天空。 

当他在树荫下休息时，我看到他身上的纹路闪耀着灵力魔法的光芒。萨满说他无耻，但我认为这是勇敢。

我应该留在我的族人身边，但我相信自己既睿智又勇敢。
texts.ZH-TW:
猛獁象獵人今天經過我們的營地。 

他號召我們加入灰燼之子。只有最明智的人才會跟隨它們，只有最勇敢的人才敢戰鬥。 

當他說到龍時，薩滿詛咒了他，但我卻熱切地仰望著天空。 

當他在樹蔭下休息時，我看到他身上的紋路閃耀著靈力魔法的光芒。薩滿說他無恥，但我認為這是勇敢。

我應該留在我的族人身邊，但我相信自己既睿智又勇敢。

texts.EN-US: Defeat Keepers roaming the world. One of them may carry the knowledge you seek.
texts.ZH-CN: 击败游荡在世界各地的野人。他们之中或许有人掌握着您所寻求的知识。
texts.ZH-TW: 擊敗遊蕩在世界各地的看守者。他們之中或許有人掌握著您所尋求的知識。

texts.EN-US:
I hear your plea. I feel your grief.

None of that changes the truth that you shamefully hid during battle - time and time again.

Once might've been excusable, but you have proven to be a dead weight. Now an earthchild has been gravely wounded and three warriors left for dead. I'd rather you were one of them than a coward. 

By order of the chief and the shaman, gather what is yours and leave by sunrise.
texts.ZH-CN:
我听到了你的请求。我能感受到你的悲伤。

这一切都无法改变你在战斗中一次又一次可耻地掩盖的真相。

一次或许还能原谅，但你已经证明自己是个累赘。现在，一名大地之子身负重伤，三名战士奄奄一息。我宁愿你是他们中的一员，而不是一个懦夫。 

奉酋长和萨满之命，收拾好你的东西，在日出前离开。
texts.ZH-TW:
我聽到了你的請求。我能感受到你的悲傷。

這一切都無法改變你在戰鬥中一次又一次可恥地掩蓋的真相。

一次或許還能原諒，但你已經證明自己是個累贅。現在，一名大地之子身負重傷，三名戰士奄奄一息。我寧願你是他們中的一員，而不是一個懦夫。 

奉酋長和薩滿之命，收拾好你的東西，在日出前離開。

texts.EN-US: Dropped by Keepers who roam the Outlands.
texts.ZH-CN: 由在异域游荡的野人掉落。
texts.ZH-TW: 由在異域遊蕩的看守者掉落。

texts.EN-US:
Some say that my senses have left me. That my mind has been lost to the Soul Streams. But who has listened to the secrets of their ancestors from millennia ago? Who has witnessed their memories? 
I have. 

I saw old Keepers erecting ancient portal obelisks. Stone by stone, sealed with Spirit Magic. Portals to a realm beyond the highest mountain tops.

And I could smell brimstone. Felt the hot breath on my face, the wind of giant wings.
texts.ZH-CN:
有人说我的感觉已经背叛我了。我的心智已沉入灵魂之流。但又有谁听过几千年前祖先留下的秘密呢？谁曾见证过他们的回忆？ 
我有。 

我看到古老的看守者竖立起远古传送门方尖碑。一块块石头，被灵魂魔法封印。通往比最高的山峰还远的国度的传送门。

我闻到了硫磺的味道。感觉到脸上的热气，像是巨翼吹来的风。
texts.ZH-TW:
有人說我的感覺已經背叛我了。我的心智已沉入靈魂之流。但又有誰聽過幾千年前祖先留下的秘密呢？誰曾見證過他們的回憶？ 
我有。 

我看到古老的看守者豎立起遠古傳送門方尖碑。一塊塊石頭，被靈魂魔法封印。通往比最高的山峰還遠的國度的傳送門。

我聞到了硫磺的味道。感覺到臉上的熱氣，像是巨翼吹來的風。

texts.EN-US: Follow an Oracle out in the world.
texts.ZH-CN: 跟随一位神谕者走出尘世。
texts.ZH-TW: 跟隨一位神諭者走出塵世。

texts.EN-US:
Of old was the age when Bur lived.
Earth was not known, nor heaven above.

Then Bur lifted the Ash of Yore. 
A world for all among limb and leaf.
With mighty roots, circling streams. 

Bur made the sun from the south
Warmed the stones of earth.
texts.ZH-CN:
很久以前，布尔生活在那个时代。
当时人们对地球一无所知，对上面的天堂也一无所知。

然后，布尔举起了往昔的灰烬。 
一个在枝叶间，人人共享的世界。
有发达的根系和环绕的溪流。 

布尔从南方创造了太阳
温暖了大地上的石头。
texts.ZH-TW:
很久以前，布爾生活在那個時代。
當時人們對地球一無所知，對上面的天堂也一無所知。

然後，布爾舉起了往昔的灰燼。 
一個在枝葉間，人人共享的世界。
有發達的根系和環繞的溪流。 

布爾從南方創造了太陽
溫暖了大地上的石頭。

texts.EN-US: Track down Keeper Rare Quarry targets for their Silver and memories.
texts.ZH-CN: 追踪野人稀有猎物目标，取得它们的银币和记忆片段。
texts.ZH-TW: 追蹤看守者稀有獵物目標，取得它們的銀幣和記憶片段。

texts.EN-US:
They call us fanatics and traitors. Warn our elders and families of our contagious madness. Implore us to be calm as earth and stone.

None of that carries any weight when we must meet evil eye to eye while they hide behind words and dreams. Only we, the Ashborn, are willing to do what is necessary.

I call them cowards!
texts.ZH-CN:
他们说我们是狂热分子和叛徒。警告我们的长辈和家人，我们这种疯狂的疾病会传染。让我们必须像泥土和石头一样平静。

当我们必须直面躲在言语和梦想背后的邪恶势力时，这一切都毫无意义。只有我们灰烬之子才愿意去做必要的事。

我说他们是懦夫！
texts.ZH-TW:
他們說我們是狂熱分子和叛徒。警告我們的長輩和家人，我們這種瘋狂的疾病會傳染。讓我們必須像泥土和石頭一樣平靜。

當我們必須直面躲在言語和夢想背後的邪惡勢力時，這一切都毫無意義。只有我們灰燼之子才願意去做必要的事。

我說他們是懦夫！

texts.EN-US: Guarded by a new Keeper preaching novel beliefs.
texts.ZH-CN: 由一位宣扬新奇信仰的新野人守护。
texts.ZH-TW: 由一位宣揚新奇信仰的新看守者守護。

texts.EN-US:
Once I believed that the cycle would protect us. Always. 

But there is something wrong with the Takers from beyond the sea. They have no care if trees regrow or herds remain. They gnaw and tear and ravage at the roots of the world as if it were to end tomorrow. 

I wondered why the cycle had forsaken us? But it is we who have forsaken the cycle! 

We presumed to know better. That petrifying the dragons for peace and politics would have no dire consequences. How arrogant to dare stand above the cycle. To defy the ancient balance of forces for our own sake. 
But it is not too late. Join me and we will right our wrongs. With fang and claw, we will be the wind beneath the dragons' wings.

I can hear the cry of the weeping world. And I know you can hear it too. Hark, deep in your bones it is straining and breaking. We must revive the cycle from its ashes. 

Answer with us, the Ashborn.
texts.ZH-CN:
我曾相信轮回会保护我们。永远会。 

但是那些来自海外的掠夺者们有些不对劲。他们根本不在乎树木是否能重新生长，牲畜是否还能存活。他们啃噬、撕裂、蹂躏世界的根基，仿佛世界明天就要毁灭。 

我想知道为什么轮回抛弃了我们？但正是我们背弃了这个轮回！ 

我们自以为比别人更聪明。为了和平与政治而将龙石化不会造成任何严重后果。竟敢凌驾于轮回之上，真是狂妄自大。为了我们自身的利益，去挑战古老的力量平衡。 
但现在还不算太晚。加入我，一起纠正我们的错误。我们将以利齿和锐爪，成为龙翼下的风。

我听到这世界哭泣的哭声。我知道你也听得到。听，你的骨头正在承受着撕裂和破碎的痛苦。我们必须让这个轮回从灰烬中重生。 

与我们，灰烬之子，一同回答。
texts.ZH-TW:
我曾相信輪迴會保護我們。永遠會。 

但是那些來自海外的掠奪者們有些不對勁。他們根本不在乎樹木是否能重新生長，牲畜是否還能存活。他們啃噬、撕裂、蹂躪世界的根基，彷彿世界明天就要毀滅。 

我想知道為什麼輪迴拋棄了我們？但正是我們背棄了這個輪迴！ 

我們自以為比別人更聰明。為了和平與政治而將龍石化不會造成任何嚴重後果。竟敢凌駕於輪迴之上，真是狂妄自大。為了我們自身的利益，去挑戰古老的力量平衡。 
但現在還不算太晚。加入我，一起糾正我們的錯誤。我們將以利齒和銳爪，成為龍翼下的風。

我聽到這世界哭泣的哭聲。我知道你也聽得到。聽，你的骨頭正在承受著撕裂和破碎的痛苦。我們必須讓這個輪迴從灰燼中重生。 

與我們，灰燼之子，一同回答。

texts.EN-US: Get more information from the leader of the Ashborn.
texts.ZH-CN: 从灰烬之子首领那里获取更多信息。
texts.ZH-TW: 從灰燼之子首領那裡獲取更多資訊。

texts.EN-US:
It's not for the old to scold the youth for their curiosity. The mere answer to a question does not quench that thirst.

Oh, but mother nature loves to adorn the gravest danger in her most alluring colors. Believe me, my brittle bones remember all too well the times I took the bait.

But to live according to the cycle means to be at ease with oneself. No material sacrifice could outweigh the truest meaning of life. What you seek is control. What you need is serenity.
texts.ZH-CN:
老人不应该因为年轻人的好奇心而责备他们。仅仅得到问题的答案并不能满足这种渴望。

哦，大自然母亲总是喜欢用她最迷人的色彩来装点最可怕的危险。相信我，我那脆弱的骨头还清楚记得我上钩的日子。

但顺应自然规律生活意味着能够与自己和解。任何物质上的牺牲都无法超越生命的真谛。你追求的是控制。你需要的是平静。
texts.ZH-TW:
老人不應該因為年輕人的好奇心而責備他們。僅僅得到問題的答案並不能滿足這種渴望。

哦，大自然母親總是喜歡用她最迷人的色彩來裝點最可怕的危險。相信我，我那脆弱的骨頭還清楚記得我上鉤的日子。

但順應自然規律生活意味著能夠與自己和解。任何物質上的犧牲都無法超越生命的真諦。你追求的是控制。你需要的是平靜。

texts.EN-US: Find a memory in a small Keeper Encampment.
texts.ZH-CN: 在小型野人营地中寻找一段回忆。
texts.ZH-TW: 在小型看守者營地中尋找一段回憶。

texts.EN-US:
Today we learned how to prepare the spicy mammoth stew. The Shaman said, "You've added enough embershroom when you're almost breathing fire."

Well, why stop at "almost"? But the Shaman told me to be careful and not overdo it, otherwise she'd have to petrify me for a thousand years.

I'm still considering whether it's worth the risk.
texts.ZH-CN:
今天我们学会了如何制作辣味猛犸炖菜。萨满说：「你吃的火星蘑菇够多了，都快要喷火了。」

嗯，为什么只满足于「快要」？但萨满告诉我要小心，不要做得太过火，否则她就得把我石化一千年。

我还在考虑是否值得冒这个险。
texts.ZH-TW:
今天我們學會了如何製作辣味猛獁燉菜。薩滿說：「你吃的火星蘑菇夠多了，都快要噴火了。」

嗯，為什麼只滿足於「快要」？但薩滿告訴我要小心，不要做得太過火，否則她就得把我石化一千年。

我還在考慮是否值得冒這個險。

texts.EN-US: Explore a communal feast in a big Keeper Encampment.
texts.ZH-CN: 探索大型野人营地中的集体盛宴。
texts.ZH-TW: 探索大型看守者營地中的集體盛宴。

texts.EN-US:
Moss unsoaked by battle. Trees older than the axe itself. 
Here we dance with the living light. Here it still feels free to breathe. 
To simply be. 

Untouched by greedy human hands. Unaffected by their need to examine and understand every fiber of the world. 

Our sanctuary will stand strong amidst the roots of time. An anchor for what has been, and for what we live and fight for.
texts.ZH-CN:
未被战火浸透的苔藓。比斧头本身还要古老的树。 
在这里，我们与鲜活的光芒共舞。在这里，呼吸之间依然自由。 
简单地存在。 

未受贪婪的人类之手染指。不受他们审视和了解世界万物需求的影响。 

我们的圣地将在时间的长河中屹立不倒。它是过去的一切的锚点，也是我们为之奋斗和生存的根基。
texts.ZH-TW:
未被戰火浸透的苔蘚。比斧頭本身還要古老的樹。 
在這裡，我們與鮮活的光芒共舞。在這裡，呼吸之間依然自由。 
簡單地存在。 

未受貪婪的人類之手染指。不受他們審視和了解世界萬物需求的影響。 

我們的聖地將在時間的長河中屹立不倒。它是過去的一切的錨點，也是我們為之奮鬥和生存的根基。

texts.EN-US: Explore the inner area where the Earthmother lives.
texts.ZH-CN: 探索大地之母居住的内部区域。
texts.ZH-TW: 探索大地之母居住的內部區域。

texts.ZH-CN: 一个不受时间侵蚀的地方
texts.ZH-TW: 一個不受時間侵蝕的地方

texts.EN-US:
We'll have to wait til morning, but I don't think our esteemed Earthdaughter will make it through the night of rites.

A new Earthmother was promised, but simply being the daughter of one is not enough. Our Earthdaughter may possess inherited wisdom but she must be as strong as the earth itself. Mind and body need to be in a heightened state to withstand the initiation.

I hope the elders know what they're doing. If we have to mourn another Earthdaughter, our time may run out.

We cannot do without our mother.
texts.ZH-CN:
我们得等到明天早上，但我认为我们尊敬的大地之女熬不过今晚的仪式了。

人们承诺会迎来一位新的大地之母，但仅仅是大地之母的女儿是不够的。我们的大地之女或许拥有传承的智慧，但她必须像地球本身一样强大。身心都需要处于高度紧张的状态才能承受考验。

我希望长者们知道自己在做什么。如果我们必须哀悼另一位大地之女，我们的时间可能就到头了。

我们离不开母亲。
texts.ZH-TW:
我們得等到明天早上，但我認為我們尊敬的大地之女熬不過今晚的儀式了。

人們承諾會迎來一位新的大地之母，但僅僅是大地之母的女兒是不夠的。我們的大地之女或許擁有傳承的智慧，但她必須像地球本身一樣強大。身心都需要處於高度緊張的狀態才能承受考驗。

我希望長者們知道自己在做什麼。如果我們必須哀悼另一位大地之女，我們的時間可能就到頭了。

我們離不開母親。

texts.EN-US: Explore the 'Deepwood Enclave' dungeon, found in the swamps of the Royal Continent.
texts.ZH-CN: 探索皇家大陆沼泽中的 Deepwood Enclave。
texts.ZH-TW: 探索皇家大陸沼澤中的 Deepwood Enclave。

texts.EN-US:
Lanu: IIII 
Rhali: IIII III
Maavhi: III
Ima: I

Rhali, if you cheat again, I'll roll your head instead.
texts.ZH-CN:
拉努：IIII 
雷利：IIII III
马维：III
伊玛：I

雷利，你要是再作弊，我就砍掉你的头。
texts.ZH-TW:
拉努：IIII 
雷利：IIII III
馬維：III
伊瑪：I

雷利，你要是再作弊，我就砍掉你的頭。

texts.EN-US: Explore a side path inside a Stoneroot Cavern.
texts.ZH-CN: 探索 Stoneroot Cavern 内的一条岔路。
texts.ZH-TW: 探索 Stoneroot Cavern 內的一條岔路。

texts.EN-US:
Join the great feast on midsummer eve.
We'll remember the battle unfold. 
When the world was young the blade we swung
Against Bur the giant of old. 
Every step she made an army was slayed
Nothing was left to withhold. 
But when she tumbled the world it rumbled
And bodies were left ice-cold. 
In our despair we dug into her
and nourished ourselves threefold.
Bur's wisdom released, our greed it ceased
As Keepers we rise tall and bold.
Since then we feast each midsummer eve
And hear the legends foretold.
texts.ZH-CN:
加入仲夏夜的盛宴吧。
我们会记住这场战斗的经过。 
世界还年轻时，我们挥舞的刀刃
对抗古老的巨人布尔。 
她每走一步，就有一支军队被屠戮
没有任何东西留下。 
但当她倒下时，世界震动起来
留下的尸体冰冷僵硬。 
在绝望中，我们深入挖掘她的尸体
并从中汲取了三倍的养分。
布尔的智慧被释放了，我们的贪婪也随之消散
身为守护者，我们昂首挺胸，英勇无畏。
从那时起，我们每年仲夏夜都会举行盛宴
并聆听那些预言中的传说。
texts.ZH-TW:
加入仲夏夜的盛宴吧。
我們會記住這場戰鬥的經過。 
世界還年輕時，我們揮舞的刀刃
對抗古老的巨人布爾。 
她每走一步，就有一支軍隊被屠戮
沒有任何東西留下。 
但當她倒下時，世界震動起來
留下的屍體冰冷僵硬。 
在絕望中，我們深入挖掘她的屍體
並從中汲取了三倍的養分。
布爾的智慧被釋放了，我們的貪婪也隨之消散
身為守護者，我們昂首挺胸，英勇無畏。
從那時起，我們每年仲夏夜都會舉行盛宴
並聆聽那些預言中的傳說。

texts.EN-US: Dropped by Keepers strong enough to challenge groups.
texts.ZH-CN: 由实力强大，需要一个队伍挑战的野人掉落。
texts.ZH-TW: 由實力強大，需要一個隊伍挑戰的看守者掉落。

texts.EN-US:
Did you know that I'm supposed to join the cycle soon? I think all the other children know, since I haven't left my bed in seasons. I think everyone knew but me. I heard the shaman whispering to our parents about it. They thought I was dreaming but I was just keeping my eyes shut really tight.

It frightened me so much, and I cried all night. I know we'll meet again in the cycle, like all those who came before, and like all one day will. But what if I get there and I don't know anyone?

Please take care of Liuh when I'm gone. She still has that hole and the left eye got loose. But I don't think she has a soul and I don't know what she'll do when I'm gone. Give her lots of hugs when she's scared, okay?
texts.ZH-CN:
你知道我很快就要加入轮回了吗？我想其他孩子都知道了，因为我好几个月都没离开过我的床。我觉得除了我自己以外，大家都知道。我听到巫师在跟我们的父母低声谈论这件事。他们以为我在做梦，但我只是紧紧闭着眼睛。

我吓坏了，哭了一整夜。我知道我们会在轮回中再次相遇，就像所有曾经存在过的人一样，也像所有终将存在的人一样。但如果我到了那里却一个熟人都没有怎么办？

我走了之后，请照顾好刘。她身上那个洞还在，左眼也松脱了。但我认为她没有灵魂，我不知道我走了以后她会做什么。她害怕的时候多抱抱她，好吗？
texts.ZH-TW:
你知道我很快就要加入輪迴了嗎？我想其他孩子都知道了，因為我好幾個月都沒離開過我的床。我覺得除了我自己以外，大家都知道。我聽到巫師在跟我們的父母低聲談論這件事。他們以為我在做夢，但我只是緊緊閉著眼睛。

我嚇壞了，哭了一整夜。我知道我們會在輪迴中再次相遇，就像所有曾經存在過的人一樣，也像所有終將存在的人一樣。但如果我到了那裡卻一個熟人都沒有怎麼辦？

我走了之後，請照顧好劉。她身上那個洞還在，左眼也鬆脫了。但我認為她沒有靈魂，我不知道我走了以後她會做什麼。她害怕的時候多抱抱她，好嗎？

texts.EN-US: Hidden behind roots in a Randomized Dungeon.
texts.ZH-CN: 隐藏在随机地下城中的树根后面。
texts.ZH-TW: 隱藏在隨機地下城中的樹根後面。

texts.EN-US:
Sir Bedivere is a fool, along with his shiny tin warriors. And, above all, their so-called king, strutting about in gold and pride.

Kill the dragons? No, no. That won't do. Politics be damned. We have to keep them safe.

Only a few still know how to cross the portals to the dragon peaks and even fewer have actually done it. There must be a way to preserve the peace and keep them alive. 
I need to convene the council. Perhaps the Oracle can help.
texts.ZH-CN:
贝德维尔爵士是个傻瓜，还有他那些闪闪发光的锡制战士。最重要的是，他们所谓的国王，趾高气扬地穿着金衣，趾高气扬地四处招摇。

杀死巨龙？不，不行。那样做行不通。政治算什么。我们必须保护他们的安全。

只有极少数人仍然知道如何穿过通往龙峰的传送门，而真正做到的人更是寥寥无几。一定有办法既能维护和平，又能让他们活下去。 
我需要召集议会。或许神谕能帮上忙。
texts.ZH-TW:
貝德維爾爵士是個傻瓜，還有他那些閃閃發光的錫製戰士。最重要的是，他們所謂的國王，趾高氣揚地穿著金衣，趾高氣揚地四處招搖。

殺死巨龍？不，不行。那樣做行不通。政治算什麼。我們必須保護他們的安全。

只有極少數人仍然知道如何穿過通往龍峰的傳送門，而真正做到的人更是寥寥無幾。一定有辦法既能維護和平，又能讓他們活下去。 
我需要召集議會。或許神諭能幫上忙。

texts.EN-US: Find a secret sanctuary behind a waterfall within a Keeper Randomized Dungeon.
texts.ZH-CN: 在野人随机地下城中，找到瀑布后面的秘密庇护所。
texts.ZH-TW: 在看守者隨機地下城中，找到瀑布後面的秘密庇護所。

texts.EN-US:
They crept into our camp by the sacred stones at night. Trying to ambush us like sleeping prey. 
But we heard their heavy boots stomping through the mud. 

Under cover of darkness we showed them what true stealth means. 
Surprise was on our side, but still they were hidden beneath layers of leather and metal, while their weapons were sharper than blades need be. 
They shrieked and roared, maligned us as maneaters. But my axes didn't care. 

Taker blood sullied our sacred stones under the cold moon light. It is not the first time, and it will not be the last.
texts.ZH-CN:
他们夜里偷偷溜进我们营地的圣石附近。他们试图像伏击熟睡的猎物一样伏击我们。 
但我们听到了他们沉重的靴子踩在泥泞中的声音。 

在夜幕的掩护下，我们向他们展示了什么才是真正的潜行。 
我们出其不意，但他们仍然隐藏在层层皮革和金属之下，而且他们的武器比刀刃本身还要锋利。 
他们尖叫咆哮，辱骂我们是食人魔。但我的斧头可不在乎。 

在冰冷的月光下，掠夺者的血玷污了我们的圣石。这并非第一次，也绝对不会是最后一次。
texts.ZH-TW:
他們夜裡偷偷溜進我們營地的聖石附近。他們試圖像伏擊熟睡的獵物一樣伏擊我們。 
但我們聽到了他們沉重的靴子踩在泥濘中的聲音。 

在夜幕的掩護下，我們向他們展示了什麼才是真正的潛行。 
我們出其不意，但他們仍然隱藏在層層皮革和金屬之下，而且他們的武器比刀刃本身還要鋒利。 
他們尖叫咆哮，辱罵我們是食人魔。但我的斧頭可不在乎。 

在冰冷的月光下，掠奪者的血玷污了我們的聖石。這並非第一次，也絕對不會是最後一次。

texts.EN-US: The quarry attacked by the Keepers still holds secrets. Search the wooden structure built by the Royal Expedition.
texts.ZH-CN: 野人袭击过的采石场仍然隐藏着秘密。寻找皇家远征军建造的木制建筑。
texts.ZH-TW: 看守者襲擊過的採石場仍然隱藏著秘密。尋找皇家遠征軍建造的木製建築。

texts.EN-US:
I got lost on the roads last night. Or rather my mind led me astray. 
I was following a strange intuition across the ancient stones when I saw him. Bathed in his own light, I managed to hide before the Avalonian even noticed me.   

But then. My gaze met his golden eyes, and suddenly he was a stranger no more. A vision bloomed behind my eyes. Like the most vivid dream. It felt as if I knew him from another life. 

I smelled the earthy forest we played in and tasted the fruit we shared by the creek - back when we were just seedlings. Long before the mist, when Merlyn had brought peace and union. 

When the spell broke, I fled. My mind is hazy, consumed by memory. How I long for that foreign feeling, to live in peace again.
texts.ZH-CN:
我昨晚在路上迷路了。或者更确切地说，是我的思想误导了我。 
我凭着一种莫名的直觉，沿着古老的石阵漫步，然后看到了他。沐浴在他自身的光芒中，我趁着阿瓦隆人还没注意到我之前就躲了起来。   

但是然后。我的目光与他金色的眼睛相遇，突然间，他不再是陌生人了。眼前浮现一幅景象。如同最生动的梦境。感觉就像我前世就认识他一样。 

我闻到了我们曾经玩耍过的泥土气息浓厚的森林的味道，尝到了我们曾经在小溪边分享的水果的味道 - 那时我们还只是小孩子。早在迷雾笼罩之前，梅林就带来了和平与统一。 

魔法解除后，我逃走了。我头脑昏沉，满脑子都是回忆。我多么渴望那种异国的感觉，多么渴望再次活在和平之中。
texts.ZH-TW:
我昨晚在路上迷路了。或者更確切地說，是我的思想誤導了我。 
我憑著一種莫名的直覺，沿著古老的石陣漫步，然後看到了他。沐浴在他自身的光芒中，我趁著阿瓦隆人還沒注意到我之前就躲了起來。   

但是然後。我的目光與他金色的眼睛相遇，突然間，他不再是陌生人了。眼前浮現一幅景象。如同最生動的夢境。感覺就像我前世就認識他一樣。 

我聞到了我們曾經玩耍過的泥土氣息濃厚的森林的味道，嚐到了我們曾經在小溪邊分享的水果的味道 - 那時我們還只是小孩子。早在迷霧籠罩之前，梅林就帶來了和平與統一。 

魔法解除後，我逃走了。我頭腦昏沉，滿腦子都是回憶。我多麼渴望那種異國的感覺，多麼渴望再次活在和平之中。

texts.EN-US: Explore the mushroom cave where Keepers brew magical potions. Some paths are hidden in plain sight.
texts.ZH-CN: 探索野人们熬制魔法药剂的蘑菇洞穴。有些道路就隐藏在人们眼皮底下。
texts.ZH-TW: 探索看守者們熬製魔法藥劑的蘑菇洞穴。有些道路就隱藏在人們眼皮底下。

texts.EN-US:
Why do we not choose to change? Yes, the cycle - but I have seen the Takers.

I wrapped myself in cloths and went there myself. To their smoking dwellings of bricks and planks. Filled with warmth and beds as soft as feathers.

And have you seen their gardens? Chickens and vegetables kept at their homes. To eat whenever they please! All kinds of creatures carried them along their broad and cobbled paths. And they carried instruments of wonder so intricate and mysterious. I couldn't even begin to imagine their purpose.

Why are such wonders wrong? Why not live in such comfort as they seem to?
texts.ZH-CN:
我们为什么不选择改变？是的，轮回往复 - 但我见过掠夺者。

我裹上衣服，独自去了那里。他们住在冒烟的砖木板房。温暖舒适，床铺柔软如羽。

你看过他们的花园吗？他们家养了鸡和蔬菜。想吃就吃！各种各样的动物沿着宽阔的鹅卵石小路驮着它们。他们携带了精巧而神秘的奇妙乐器。我根本无法想像他们的目的是什么。

为什么这些奇思妙想是错的？为什么不过他们那种看起来很舒适的生活呢？
texts.ZH-TW:
我們為什麼不選擇改變？是的，輪迴往復 - 但我見過掠奪者。

我裹上衣服，獨自去了那裡。他們住在冒煙的磚木板房。溫暖舒適，床鋪柔軟如羽。

你看過他們的花園嗎？他們家養了雞和蔬菜。想吃就吃！各種各樣的動物沿著寬闊的鵝卵石小路馱著它們。他們攜帶了精巧而神秘的奇妙樂器。我根本無法想像他們的目的是什麼。

為什麼這些奇思妙想是錯的？為什麼不過他們那種看起來很舒適的生活呢？

texts.EN-US: Explore the area above the Keeper Dungeon 'Stoneroot Caverns'. But beware: it's dangerous to go alone.
texts.ZH-CN: 探索野人地下城 'Stoneroot Caverns' 上方的区域。但要小心：独自前往很危险。
texts.ZH-TW: 探索看守者地下城「Stoneroot Caverns」上方的區域。但要小心：獨自前往很危險。

texts.EN-US: I peered into their empty eye sockets and saw a glimmer of being! Like a shard of soul, trapped in grief as old as the mists. My heart is heavy with their sorrow. It is our fault. Merlyn's gravest mistake. I will free them, whatever it takes.
texts.ZH-CN: 我凝视着他们空洞的眼窝，看到了一丝生命的光芒！如同灵魂碎片，被困在与迷雾一样古老的悲伤之中。他们的悲伤让我感到无比沉重。这是我们的错。梅林犯下的最严重的错误。无论如何，我都要救他们。
texts.ZH-TW: 我凝視著他們空洞的眼窩，看到了一絲生命的光芒！如同靈魂碎片，被困在與迷霧一樣古老的悲傷之中。他們的悲傷讓我感到無比沉重。這是我們的錯。梅林犯下的最嚴重的錯誤。無論如何，我都要救他們。

texts.EN-US: Explore a dungeon where the Keepers meet the Undead.
texts.ZH-CN: 探索野人与亡灵相遇的地下城。
texts.ZH-TW: 探索看守者與不死族相遇的地下城。

texts.EN-US:
Earthmother, mother of life. 

Where you touch the earth, it touches my soul.
Where you touch the earth, life will grow.

Yours is the heart that beats along the breath of beasts. 
Yours is the flesh that grows alongside blossom, bush, and bark. 
Yours is the charge to keep the earth as it was meant to be. 

Earthmother guide me and grant me peace.
texts.ZH-CN:
大地之母，生命之母。 

你触及大地之处，也触及我的灵魂。
你触及大地之处，生命就会成长。

你的心跳与野兽的呼吸同步。 
你的血肉与花、灌木和树皮一同生长。 
你的职责是保持地球原有的样貌。 

大地之母，请指引我，赐我平静。
texts.ZH-TW:
大地之母，生命之母。 

你觸及大地之處，也觸及我的靈魂。
你觸及大地之處，生命就會成長。

你的心跳與野獸的呼吸同步。 
你的血肉與花、灌木和樹皮一同生長。 
你的職責是保持地球原有的樣貌。 

大地之母，請指引我，賜我平靜。

texts.EN-US: At the northern edge of the forest where the Earthmother resides, a secret passage lies hidden behind the roots of a giant tree.
texts.ZH-CN: 在大地之母居住的森林北缘，一棵巨树的树根后面隐藏着一条秘密通道。
texts.ZH-TW: 在大地之母居住的森林北緣，一棵巨樹的樹根後面隱藏著一條秘密通道。

texts.EN-US:
I've bad news to share. Your beloved has joined the streams. 

We followed the hunters' tracks toward the setting sun up to the small pine forest. That's where we found their bodies. We tried, but no survivors. They were riddled by arrows. I could only recognize your beloved by his ink. 

We'll bring what is left for the burial. Stay strong.
texts.ZH-CN:
我有个坏消息要告诉大家。你最爱的人已经加入了魂流。 

我们循着猎人的足迹，朝着落日的方向，来到了那片小松树林。我们在那里发现了他们的遗体。我们尽力了，但没有幸存者。他们身上布满了箭孔。我只能透过他身上的刺青来认出你的爱人。 

我们会把剩下的东西带去办葬礼。坚强点。
texts.ZH-TW:
我有個壞消息要告訴大家。你最愛的人已經加入了魂流。 

我們循著獵人的足跡，朝著落日的方向，來到了那片小松樹林。我們在那裡發現了他們的遺體。我們盡力了，但沒有倖存者。他們身上佈滿了箭孔。我只能透過他身上的刺青來認出你的愛人。 

我們會把剩下的東西帶去辦葬禮。堅強點。

texts.ZH-CN: 下一个更新的开放世界改动
texts.ZH-TW: 下次更新的開放世界變更

texts.EN-US:
Adventurer,

With Albion's next content update, scheduled for late November, all open-world zones will have their terrain, layouts, and visuals updated.

When the update launches, your player character will be moved to the entrance of the zone they were in when the update was deployed, and ALL FURNITURE (INCLUDING CRATES) left in the open world will be DESTROYED. Please be sure to collect any furniture placed in the open world that you wish to save before then.

Additionally, Hideouts will remain in approximately the same part of the zone, but may be moved slightly and may also have different surroundings. You will be allowed one manual move per Hideout, within the same zone, within the first 72 hours after the update launches.

For more information on these changes, keep an eye on our news page and forum.

- Your Albion Online Team
texts.ZH-CN:
冒险者，

随着阿尔比恩预定在11月下旬实装的下一个游戏内容更新，所有开放世界区域中的地形、地图布局和视觉效果都将被更新。

当更新上线时，您的玩家角色将被移动到他们当时所在区域的入口。并且，所有留在开放世界中的家具物品（包括所有容器）都将被自动摧毁。若您想要保存您放置在开放世界中的家具物品，请务必在此之前取回它们。

此外，藏身地堡将保留它们原先在该区域的相对位置，但可能因地形改动而略微移动，也可能受到周围环境更动的影响。在更新上线后的72小时内，所有藏身地堡将可以在其所在区域内被手动移动一次。

若要了解关于这些改动的更多详细信息，请关注我们的新闻页面和论坛。

- 您的阿尔比恩Online团队
texts.ZH-TW:
致冒險者：

在下次的《阿爾比恩》內容更新中(預計11月底推出)，全新的開放世界區域的地形、布局和視覺效果將有所更新。

更新釋出時，您的玩家角色將會移動至更新釋出時所在區域的入口，而所有放置在開放世界的家具(包含木箱)都會被摧毀。如果想要保留那些家具，請務必在更新之前取回。

另外，藏身地堡會維持在相同區域的原位置附近，但地點可能略有不同，而且可能會有不同的環境。更新釋出後72小時內，每個藏身地堡可以手動移動一次，移動範圍僅限相同區域。

詳細變更資訊請密切追蹤官方最新消息頁面和論壇。

-《阿爾比恩Online》團隊

texts.EN-US: Reminder: Rare Mounts with Percival Update
texts.ZH-CN: 温馨提示：珀西瓦里更新的稀有坐骑相关问题

texts.EN-US:
Adventurer,

With the release of the Percival Update on July 10, we're converting numerous mounts into items that you can use to permanently unlock their respective skin for your account. If you're using one of the affected mounts when Percival goes live, it will NOT be equipped, will NOT be rideable, and you will lose any load bonus you might have received from it. If you want to make sure you can move effectively once you log back in, make sure you are not actively using one of these mounts when the update is deployed.

The following mounts are affected:

Riding Horses:
- Legendary Explorer's Horse
- Legendary Adventurer's Horse
- Horse Macabre
- Bonehorse
- Recruiter's Horse
- Recruiter's Pony

Armored Horses:
- Arena Veteran's Armored Horse
- Morgana Mare

Oxen:
- Legendary Explorer's Ox
- Legendary Adventurer's Cart
- Recruiter's Yak
- Recruiter's Bighorn Ram

Direwolves:
- Ghostwolf 
- Specter Wolf
- Recruiter's Grey Wolf
- Recruiter's Dire Fox
- Recruiter's Saint Bernard
- Recruiter's Rottweiler
- Recruiter's Husky Sled

Stags:
- Master's Giant Stag
- Yule Stag
- Recruiter's Giant Stag
- Recruiter's Impala

Cougars:
- Arena Veteran's Armored Sabertooth
- Sabertooth Rex
- Recruiter's Tiger
- Recruiter's White Tiger

Direboars:
- Domesticated Hog
- Recruiter's Pig

Lizards:
- Recruiter's Sand Salamander

Donkeys:
- Jack o' Donkey
- Recruiter's Donkey

Sincerely,
Your Albion Online Team
texts.ZH-CN:
冒险者，

7月10日珀西瓦里更新上线后，我们会将多种坐骑转换为解锁物品，使用此物品即可为账号永久解锁对应坐骑的皮肤。珀西瓦里上线时，如果您正在使用以下坐骑，您将无法装备、骑乘坐骑，并且会丢失坐骑的负重加成。如果您不希望在重新登录时受到影响，导致无法有效移动，请勿在更新进行前装备以下坐骑。

受影响坐骑包括：

骑乘马：
- 传奇探险者成年马
- 传奇冒险者成年马
- 恐怖魂驹
- 白骨马
- 推广大使成年马
- 推广大使小马

- 莫甘娜雌马

- 传奇冒险者手拉车
- 推广大使牦牛
- 推广大使大角公羊

- 推广大使凶暴野狐
- 推广大使圣伯纳德犬
- 推广大使罗威纳犬
- 推广大使哈士奇雪橇

雄鹿：
- 大师级巨鹿
- 耶鲁雄鹿
- 推广大使巨鹿
- 推广大使黑斑羚

美洲狮：
- 竞技场老练级铠甲剑齿虎
- 剑齿虎雷克斯
- 推广大使猛虎
- 推广大使白虎

texts.EN-US:
Greetings, Adventurer!

Your journey in Albion has now begun! Along with access to the game, we've started you off with a free week of Premium status.

In addition to giving a bonus to Fame earned and increased harvesting yield, it allows you to participate in the monthly Adventurer's Challenges with exclusive rewards, as well as granting daily Focus and Learning Points. You can always extend your Premium status with a subscription, or through in-game currency - click the crown icon in the upper right corner for more info.

Welcome to Albion - get ready to forge your own destiny!

- Your Albion Online Team
texts.ZH-CN:
您好，冒险者！

您在阿尔比恩的旅程现已开始！在您开启旅程之前，我们还将为您提供了一周的免费尊享特权。

有了尊享特权，您不仅可以享受声望获得和采集产出加成，还可以参加每月冒险者挑战，赢取专属奖励，此外之外，您每天还能获得专注点与学习点数。 您可以随时通过订阅或花费游戏获得延长尊享特权时间——点击右上角的皇冠图标，即可获取更多关于尊享特权的信息。

欢迎来到阿尔比恩——您的命运，掌握在您自己手中！

——阿尔比恩OL团队
texts.ZH-TW:

Fellow Adventurer,

A very happy holiday season to you!

We at Sandbox Interactive want to thank you for your continued support - Albion Online would not be what it is today without you.

To celebrate this festive occasion, we've attached some fireworks and snowballs for you.

We look forward to seeing you in Albion!
